summary:
The integration pass for this wave passed: tests, native suites, install, and no engine diff.

- **Tests:** the full Swift runner passed twice (505/505, 0 failures). gen-tokens/gen-icons --check and all 8 tools/test-*.py pass.
- **Native suites:** all pass under the lock. The audio suite passed 10/10, so the old shutdown flake is gone.
- **Engine diff** against upstream-base-2026-10-14 for src, lib, include and modules/gui/macosx is empty.
- **Snapshots:** mxr-snapshot check --all went from 15 PASS · 49 REVIEW · 43 FAIL (re-measured on fae8f04dc0) to 21 · 64 · 31, with no entry getting worse. The remaining FAILs are mostly offscreen-blur limits, decided deviations or onboarding crop strips. A few are real Δ2–3 colour differences that no decision covers (S43/S44 App top bar, S34 music bar, VolumeCone gradient, S64 Save fill).
- **Install:** install-app.sh succeeded and the app was not launched. Only /Applications/VLC.app (untouched, 1743527633) and /Applications/VLC Redesign.app exist. The build dir has no leftover VLC.app, and a clean release build of MXRPlugin has 0 Swift warnings.
- **My two fixes**, both gallery-only:
  - removed a Swift 6 warning in CustomizationGallery.swift;
  - added the D048 seek-head deviation to S01.App/default, so it uses the same rule as S01.Window/shipping.
- **Lock** is released. Nothing was committed; the orchestrator commits.

Evidence is in ../build/evidence/final4/integration/ (31 MB): verdict-changes.txt, check-all.log, check-all-fae8f04dc0.log, native-*.log, install.log, swift-tests-1.log and swift-tests-2.log, clean-release-build.log, and check/<entry>/report.txt with side-by-side images for FAILs.
